subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3531
title: Directs the Commission on Indian Services to employ a natural resources management tribal liaison officer to facilitate opportunities for integrated natural resources management between Indian tribes and state agencies with natural resources management duties.
headline: HB 3531 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3531 was introduced in the House on February 11, 2025.

Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
